method: angle of repose, poured heap on a fixed 12 mm base (ISO 4324 style, reduced scale)
notes: Real-size salt grains (no coarse-graining), E reduced to 2e5 Pa. Profile-fit angle = slope of the sector-averaged heap surface for 1.0 < r < 5.2 mm; apex angle = atan(apex height / base radius) as in ISO 4324.
